notes.title: WELCOME TO BETA 3.0
notes.content:
Hello Ladies and Gents,

We're happy to bring to life the Beta 3.0 version of Once Upon A Siege.  After a month full of changes, we now have the game in a new state, with many problematic bugs fixed, additions and gameplay adjustments.


[b]The goals for Beta 3.0 were :[/b]
(Items not struck-through will carry on to the February update BETA 4.0)

*  [strike]GAMEPLAY TUNING LEVELS 4 - 10[/strike]
*  [strike]AI & PATHFINDING IMPROVEMENTS[/strike]
*  [strike]1ST GENERATION OF HIGH SCORE SYSTEM[/strike]
*  [strike]PERFORMANCE OPTIMISATION FOR LEVELS 7 - 10[/strike]
*  [strike]WORKING SHOPKEEP[/strike]
*  [strike]POPULATE SHOP WITH PROPS[/strike]
*  OPTIONS SCREEN FUNCTIONAL WITH FIRST SET OF OPTIONS
*  REFINED BAND IN ENTERTAINMENT AREA
* [strike] ENTERTAINMENT AREA AND HUB POPULATED WITH PROPS[/strike]
*  PLACEHOLDERS REPLACED WITH PROPER ASSETS
*  [strike]SOUND FX PLACEHOLDERS REPLACED WITH PROPER SFX[/strike]


[h3][b]WHAT'S CHANGED?[/b][/h3]
Aside from the list above, which consists of the major updates needed for the game to keep evolving, there has been a plethora of changes during the last month that came in the form of small updates and patches.  Please see the respective update notes for information.


[h3][b]HOW HAVE ALL THESE CHANGES AFFECTED THE GAME?[/b][/h3]
*  The interaction system now works well and game-breaking bugs in the system have been ironed out.
*  AI behaviour and pathfinding have been attended to, ensuring more fluid gameplay.
*  Enemy NPC units have been rebalanced and their mechanics tuned to make the game more dynamic and quite a bit harder, especially in the later levels.
*  Player upgrades have also been worked on to allow the player a chance for survival, especially in the later levels.
*  The Space Station has been visually re-worked as a base style and will continue to be refined and evolved.   
*  Tutorial has been attended to with new additions.  This game has a lot going on and the tutorial is one of the most important things right now.
*  Sound effects have been re-organised and refreshed. 
*  Gameplay from levels 4 -10 has been tuned.  This is only the first generation of tuning for these levels and we will continue to plug away at making them even more refined in the coming weeks and months. 


[h3][b]WHAT'S NEXT FOR THE GAME?[/b][/h3]
Beta 4.0 is next and with it we wish to see the next phase of Siege's evolution.  Apart from including on-going changes to Graphics, Sound and Gameplay, we have the following goals for 4.0 in our sights : 

*  FURTHER BALANCING OF LEVELS 7 - 10
*  FURTHER BALANCING AND TUNING OF OVERALL GAMEPLAY
*  SECOND AUDIO PASS
*  PARTICLE EFFECTS PASS
*  ASSET / PROPS PASS
*  NEW NPC 'MOLE' UNIT
*  NEW LEVEL GENERATOR FOR GAMEPLAY DIVERSITY
*  ALL LEVEL TERRAINS REDONE OR REFINED
*  10 EXTRA TERRAINS TO CREATE SOME VARIETY OF PLAYFIELD FOR SIEGES
*  RENDERING OPTIMISATION.  REDUCE DRAWCALLS BY INTRODUCING STRICTER BATCHING
*  UPDATED LIGHTMAPS FOR ALL LEVELS
*  A WORKING OPTIONS SCREEN WITH FIRST SET OF OPTIONS

After Beta 4.0, our goal is to begin implementing Multi-Player Co-Op and the beginning of a League System for Beta 5.0 and beyond.  This will add a new dimension to what will by then be a balanced and robust game.


See you in the Siege,

Sincerely, Black Stream Boys.

notes.title: WELCOME LADIES AND GENTS
notes.content:
Hello Gamers!


We're delighted you decided to take a foray into this honest and unpretentious little game and we hope it brings you fun.  It's a game developed by 2 dudes  (one whom creatively directed and one whom developed) that are long time gamers.  In fact you could say, that we're 'old school gamers', so taking a classic game like Rampart and making it VR-worthy is something that tickled our interest.

However, it's a young little thing and needs some room to grow, so in the next coming months our goal is to tune, polish and refine it and let it mature into something a bit more than a 10-level romp through various armies and levels.

Despite it not being huge, it carries with it some interesting mechanics and gameplay that begs to be expanded and this is exactly what we plan to do.  So we've outlined a few milestones that are in our sights for version 1.0 and we'd like to share them with you.  The goals are listed in order of priority and time and will be completed over the next few months.

[h3][b]REFINED AI & TUNED GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3]
Gameplay and smoothly functioning AI is of paramount importance to fun.  So above all else, our focus until 1.0 is gameplay balance and AI that always knows what it's doing. 

[h3][b]FRIENDLIER FIRST-TIME PLAYER EXPERIENCE[/b][/h3]
It's not a complicated game, but it does have a slight learning curve and we're going to make it more accessible to new players with a tutorial that expands upon the present one.

[h3][b]GRAPHICS PASS[/b][/h3]
Over the next couple of months, the remaining environmental terrain and 3d assets will be overhauled in order to pretty everything up.  We do like the pseudo low-poly style so that will stay, however quality of graphics will change for the better.  

The next very important thing, which will happen progressively, is populating the game world with stuff.    The space station will be full of stuff and the levels will be of props, and visual effects.

And yes, that abstract entertainment area will have more bands and more songs and things to do.

[h3][b]SOUNDS[/b][/h3]
As for the graphics, the same goes for the sounds.  By final release, sound effects will be fleshed out and the soundtrack shall expand.

[h3][b]NEW NPC UNITS AND NEW UPGRADES[/b][/h3]
Even though there already is NPC unit variety in-game, we shall add even more.  A game like this deserves as many interesting ways to storm a keep as possible.  It also requires as many fun upgrades as possible,

[h3][b]RANDOM LEVEL & NPC ARMY GENERATION[/b][/h3]
For replayability's sake.  A level manager that randomises terrain and NPC armies.

[h3][b]CO-OP PLAY[/b][/h3]
This is the big one as it shall add an extra dimension to the game.  With a level designer in place for maximum gameplay variety, the need to defend the keep with your friend suddenly arises.  

Over the next few days, we'll start adding links to quick gameplay tutorials and post them here and also start adding these tutorial videos to some in-game screens, or perhaps a service droid at the space station where they can be accessed quickly in between sieges.

Any bugs you encounter, please don't hesitate to post them, the more we squash, the better.

Happy sieging!

Blackstream Boys
